title: Denial Reason Routing Table and Write-Off Limits — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
Denied and adjusted amounts on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) are routed by their claim adjustment reason code. The routing table is the same in every payer class:

| Reason code | Work route |
|---|---|
| CO-16, CO-4, CO-11 | correct and resubmit |
| CO-197 | provider appeal with authorization evidence |
| CO-50 | medical-necessity appeal |
| CO-29 | write off unless timely-filing proof is held |
| CO-22 | bill the other payer first |
| CO-109 | bill the correct payer |
| CO-18 | no action (duplicate) |
| PR-27 | transfer to the patient (coverage terminated) |
| PR-204 | transfer to the patient if the waiver was signed |
| CO-96 | write off, no patient billing |

**Settings common to every payer class**
- Every full denial and front-end rejection is worked within 10 calendar days of the denial.
- Amounts in the claim adjustment groups CO, OA and PI may never be billed to the patient.
- Riverbend may not bill the patient above the patient-responsibility amounts the payer reports (balance billing is prohibited).
- A non-covered amount may be billed to the patient only with a signed advance waiver on file.

**Small-denial write-off amount and advance waiver by payer class**

| Payer class | Small-denial write-off amount (USD; a denied amount at or below it is not worth appealing) | Advance notice the patient must have signed before a non-covered service |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 50 | Riverbend Financial Responsibility Waiver |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 50 | Riverbend Financial Responsibility Waiver |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 50 | Riverbend Financial Responsibility Waiver |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | 75 | Riverbend Financial Responsibility Waiver |
| Original Medicare Claim | 75 | CMS-R-131 Advance Beneficiary Notice |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 100 | ForwardHealth Non-Covered Service Agreement |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | 50 | Riverbend Financial Responsibility Waiver |

Example (hypothetical): a denied amount of 75.00 on a Medicare Advantage Plan Claim is at the small-denial amount for that class; the same 75.00 on a Commercial PPO Claim is above it.
